sources.title: The Plight Of Trans Women In Prison
sources.claim_summary: BuzzFeed News feature (Jan 2018, French context): trans women in France incarcerated on the basis of their legal gender fall into a legal gray area - relevant to Réunion as a French overseas department applying French law.

CGLPL opinion of 25 May 2021 on the treatment of transgender persons in places of deprivation of liberty (French context, applicable in Réunion): serious violations persist across places of detention.

sources.title: » L’«identité sexuelle» devient un motif de discrimination dans le code pénal
sources.claim_summary: Yagg (July 2012, in French): 'sexual identity' became a discrimination ground in the French Penal Code (Article L225-1) - enabling prosecution of transphobia; French law applies in Réunion.

sources.title: » L’Assemblée nationale adopte l’amendement visant à faciliter le changement d’état civil pour les personnes trans
sources.claim_summary: Yagg (May 2016, in French): the National Assembly adopted amendment 282 facilitating legal gender change for trans people - though its scope could be limited by three government sub-amendments; French law applies in Réunion.
